title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 112
paragraphs: During this interval of time, while Xerxes was conversing with his brother, Amestris had sent Xerxes's spearmen to bring the wife of Masistes, and she was inflicting shameful outrage on her: she cut away her breasts and threw them to the dogs, and she cut off her nose, ears, lips, and tongue, and sent her home so mutilated.
